lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p32 - 1. Listen to the story.

details: Listen gives students practise of comprehension of the story.
Look for careful listening and following of the story.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down:

Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs
